Today, Sarah went to the bakery. Between what times could they have gone?

Sarah woke up at 9am.
John saw Sarah getting a coffee at the cafe from 10am to 12pm.
Thomas saw Sarah buying lunch at the deli from 12pm to 4pm.
Richard saw Sarah driving to the water park from 4pm to 5pm.
The bakery was closed after 5pm.
Between what times could Sarah have gone to the bakery?

Options:
(A) 4pm to 5pm
(B) 12pm to 4pm
(C) 9am to 10am
(D) 10am to 12pm

Think step by step about the question. Keep reasoning concise (under 300 words). Then give your final answer on the last line in exactly this format: Answer: (X)

- Sarah cannot have gone to the bakery between 4pm and 5pm because she was seen driving to the water park during this time.
- The bakery was closed after 5pm, so Sarah could not have gone there after that time.

The only time slot that fits all these conditions is between 9am and 10am.
